items.title: Rudolph Beaulieu Interview, 1961-05-31
items.q: He was playing with Nanga Perez's brass band.

ctx.x: Uh... Listen. Old man Contrell was living on this side of the street. I'm living on this side of the street. Oh, really? A big, tall fella, brown skin. He was playing with Nanga Perez's brass band.
